task.summary:
feat: initial
- Add ASP.NET Core Web API project - Configure PostgreSQL with EF Core - Add entities: User, Subscription, UserSettings, Article - Add entity configurations and AppDbContext - Add HealthController for /api/health - Add Swagger for API testing - Add initial migration"

feat: add RSS parser with unit tests + inline keyboard
- Add NewsParser with RSS parsing support - Add SourceType detection (RSS/NewsAPI/HTML) - Add unit tests for RSS parser: - Valid RSS feed parsing - Network error handling - Missing fields handling - Add Moq for HttpClient mocking in tests

feat: improve topic detection + integrate AI summarization for new articles + ApiNewsParser
- Add OpenAI ChatGPT summarization for each new article - Use Description or Title for summarization text - Store summary in Article.Summary field - Add logging for summarization progress - Summarization only for deduplicated articles" - Extend TopicDetector with gaming, archaeology, and IT keywords - Add new RSS sources for gaming (igromania.ru) and science (naked-science.ru) - Optimize MainNewsParser with batch deduplication - Reduce 'General' category false positives"

refactor: extract database and source operations to separate services
- Add ArticleService for article deduplication, save, and search - Add SourceService for source management (active sources, priority) - Refactor MainNewsParser to use ArticleService and SourceService - Reduce MainNewsParser responsibility to orchestration only - Update TopicDetector with gaming, archaeology, and IT keywords - Fix duplicate URL issue in NewsParser CreateArticle - Update tests to work with new services"
